assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D painted garment texture atlas for a small isometric 3D game. The reference image is STYLE ONLY: emulate its confident visible angular brushwork, richly painted cloth folds, warm ochre highlights, colored shadow planes and clearly painted stitching. Do not reproduce its character or turnaround layout. Create ONE portrait 1024 x 1536 image, an exact edge-to-edge 2-column by 3-row grid of six equally sized RECTANGULAR, FULL-BLEED cloth panels, with NO margins, gaps, outlines, labels, text, people, silhouettes or grey background. All six rectangles are completely covered in painted fabric; this is flat garment surface artwork, not garments floating on a background. Top left: FRONT of an 1890s cream stockyard laborer's work shirt, projected flat onto the whole rectangle. A small pointed cream collar at the top center, a center vertical button placket with a few worn painted buttons, two brown braces running vertically at 30% and 70% width from top to bottom, double stitch highlights and scuffed leather tabs; strong but tasteful diagonal cloth folds at waist and chest. Top right: BACK of same cream shirt, broad shoulder/yoke fold highlights and two brown braces crossing in the upper middle. Middle left: FRONT dark olive-brown canvas trouser fabric, large hand-painted thigh and knee folds, side pockets at the top corners, painted center fly, seams and wear. Entire rectangle remains cloth with no leg-shaped cutout or background. Middle right: BACK of those trousers, two painted welt pockets high up, seat tension folds, worn knee-height creasing below; full-bleed canvas. Bottom left: uninterrupted cream shirt sleeve cloth, broad diagonal elbow compression folds, a few small ochre scuffs, beautifully readable angular painted highlights; no straps, buttons or pockets. Bottom right: brown wool cap cloth, large irregular brushed wool color planes, several curving gore seam lines with light worn edges and a dark stitched band across the bottom quarter. All colors richer and more painterly than flat fills; no photorealistic noise, no plastic, no modern logos. The folds, seams and shading should do the work on a simple low-poly mesh.

Match the visible angular brush marks, bold fabric highlights, warm colored shadows, painted stitching and hand-painted material richness of AFT3D, not photorealistic cloth scans or smooth flat colors. Top left panel: faded indigo-blue collared shirt FRONT, small pointed collar at top center, painted center placket and dull buttons, broad rumpled chest and waist folds. Top right: BACK of blue shirt, shoulder yoke and rumpled folds, narrow cream apron neck strap at the top and thin apron waist ties near bottom. Middle left: FRONT warm dark charcoal canvas trouser fabric with side pockets, central fly and strong painted thigh/knee tension folds, all rectangular cloth. Middle right: BACK charcoal trousers with two high pockets, scuffed edges and broad angular seat/knee folds; no silhouettes. Bottom left: uninterrupted faded blue sleeve cloth, compressed elbow wrinkles, pale brushy fold edges, gentle work wear; no buttons, braces or logos. Bottom right: a full-bleed light unbleached cream canvas apron surface: painted upper hem, one simple stitched pocket centered a third of the way down, long vertical tension folds and diagonal lower creases, subtle dusty ochre grime toward bottom, no blood or writing. Consistent broad brush scale and material painting across every panel. The atlas is the finished game texture, not a presentation mockup.
